lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: There's a repeating pattern in the channel noise. Automated pulse. Someone's still broadcasting on the old Dominion bands.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Dominion bands are mostly silent out here. Too much space between listening posts. Too many years of neglect.

lines.speaker: Automated Beacon
lines.text: Ronin-7. Ronin-7. Report. Ronin-7. Report.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's a direct designation call. That's a summons.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: It's not a summons. It's an echo. Something dead calling to something that refused to die.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Set course for the signal source. We're going to answer.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Station's been dark for years. Emergency lighting on maintenance cycles. Someone's still keeping the power running.

lines.speaker: Coral Vex
lines.text: The relay designation predates current Dominion protocols by twelve years. It's older than the unified command structure.

lines.speaker: Morrigan
lines.text: A personal listening post. Maintained in secret. Someone did not want this station catalogued in any official system.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Morrigan, Coral, hold the hauler. I'm going in.

lines.speaker: Automated Defense System
lines.text: ALERT. Unauthorized access to restricted maintenance array. Intruder suppression protocol activated. Engage defensive measures.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: If Ronin-7 ever wakes, if you're hearing this transmission, tell him the children he freed are still alive.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I couldn't pull the trigger. I tried to order it, a kill-order, standard protocol, the erasure of witnesses. I gave the command, and then I...

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher? What is that?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The confession I was always going to find.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I've got the core unpacked. Operational manifests, all indexed by date. Sector Desolat-Omega, five years back. One entry surfaces here, "Operative-7 deployment."

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Target designation: cybernetics breeding site. The fragment notes read, "subject reported contradiction between target identity and mission brief." Escalation to Khall. Khall authorized. Operative executed contingency.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: They cleared me to do something I didn't want to do.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Khall overrode your hesitation himself. Put it in writing. Made it command authority.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm not looking for my past anymore, Kessler. I'm looking for proof of a lie I already know is true.

lines.speaker: Gilded Maw Operative
lines.text: Ronin-7. You're still alive. The Dominion said you were purged. They said you were gone.

lines.speaker: Gilded Maw Operative
lines.text: You're chasing a ghost relay in a dead sector. The Dominion doesn't remember your name, you're a loose wire they flicked.

lines.speaker: Gilded Maw Operative
lines.text: But the Pale Choir heard it. The Vellum Exchange heard it. The Hollow Kings heard it. You broke, and every faction wants to know what's rattling around in your skull.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher, I'm reading a second contact in the system. Deeper in. Moving toward the third world.

lines.speaker: Mirs
lines.text: Relay-9 was a personal listening post. Not in any official registry. Someone's private insurance policy against the rest of the Program.

lines.speaker: Mirs
lines.text: My sources say the Overseer who maintained it was Khall. He kept records of the children who survived what you were ordered to do. Whether that makes him good or just guilty, I leave to you.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: He triggered my wipe after Kethel-7. And then he tried to take it back.

lines.speaker: Mirs
lines.text: He petitioned the Program's central authority for a reversal. They refused him. And then he went silent, leaving breadcrumbs through dead relays, hoping someone strong enough to follow them eventually would wake up and hear the truth.

lines.speaker: Emberhand Enforcer Lead
lines.text: Intruders in the warbound sector! Engage containment protocols!

lines.speaker: Mirs
lines.text: Khall did something that should have destroyed him. After he triggered your purge, he went to the Program's central authority and asked for an exception, a reversal.

lines.speaker: Mirs
lines.text: They said no. They said your failure had to be complete. They said the program cannot tolerate mercy.

lines.speaker: Mirs
lines.text: He couldn't stop them. So he started keeping records. Dead channels. Personal relays. A path for you to follow when you woke up.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: He engineered his own confession.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: There's a full archive buffer. All of it recorded. All of it waiting.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: The Ronin program is the Dominion's greatest lie. I have spent my career administering it. I have sent operative candidates to their deaths because they knew too much. I have reprogrammed operatives to forget their own names. And I have justified every single choice as necessity.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Ronin-7 was different. He refused the kill-order at Kethel-7. He broke the chain I had spent years hoping someone would break.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I chose him because he showed signs of conscience. I am sorry it took a massacre of innocents to prove me right.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: If you are hearing this, I have already tried and failed to undo what I set in motion. The truth is louder than I can silence. I am letting it bleed.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I am recording this knowing it will be destroyed. I am recording this knowing it will be found. Both of those things are true. And I choose to record it anyway.

lines.speaker: Pale Choir Assassin Lead
lines.text: The archive must remain silent. Your presence here is an anomaly we are authorized to correct.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Choir is burning serious resources to stop you from hearing that confession. That means it matters. That means it's real. That means Khall was right, the truth is louder than they can silence.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Khall was not just an Overseer covering his tracks. He deliberately let his guilt broadcast outward into the void, betting someone would find it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Program is cracking from within. The truth is becoming un-buryable.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I engineered your resistance, Operative-7. Not consciously, I chose you because you showed signs of breaking.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: When the massacre happened and you refused the kill-order, I knew the contradiction had held. The Program's logic requires perfect compliance. You proved it is imperfect.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Why did you let the confessions bleed through dead channels instead of coming forward?

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Because what I know would undo them. And they know I know it.

lines.speaker: Dominion Squad Lead
lines.text: All teams converge! Overseer is mobile! Containing spread!

lines.speaker: Syndicate Hunter Lead
lines.text: Ronin-7 is in-theater! Full suppression! Don't let him reach the Overseer!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: He's gone. We lost him.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: He's not gone. He's loose. And the confession is loose with him.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Khall is alive. The confession is bleeding across the void. The Program has a crack running through it that no one can plug.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Dominion will destroy this station the moment they detect the signal. It will be their first priority.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Then it needs to be loud before it dies.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Dominion will come. The Pale Choir will come. Every faction that hears this frequency will converge on this point.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Then we buy it time.

lines.speaker: Dreadnought Commander
lines.text: All point-defense, converge on the fighter! It's broadcasting the whole network! Destroy the relay!

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Relay-9 is dark. The signal is scattered. The Dominion can't stop what's already moving.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I've been moving through space for months, following dead channels and broken beacons.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I've heard Khall's confession. I've watched the Dominion burn a relay to erase the truth. I've seen the machine finally crack.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And now I'm sitting in a stolen ship, alone in the dark, looking at my hands and asking a question.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Is there any life after being a weapon?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The confession keeps spreading. They can't stop what Khall set in motion.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: He opened a door. The only question now is who walks through it.
